ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Base64 Encoded User-Agent
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious encoded User-Agent strings, as seen used by some malware. Note: Unmapped fields: c-useragent

sequences.query: (c-useragent = RGX("^Q2hyb21l") OR c-useragent = RGX("^QXBwbGVXZWJLaX") OR c-useragent = RGX("^RGFsdmlr") OR c-useragent = RGX("^TW96aWxsY"))
